subject: Re: ArborAI outage - SLA credit request and calculation
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Matthews <jordan@arborai.com>, ArborAI Billing <billing@arborai.com>
Cc: support@redwood.com
Date: 2027-08-29T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Incident: token-generation errors impacting ArborAI (Aug 29)

Hi Jordan —

Wanted to follow up with an initial summary from our side. On 2027-08-29 at ~02:23 UTC we observed a service degradation impacting the tokens generation endpoint for requests routed to our us-west region. The root cause was a regression in a routing heuristic that led to an overloaded GPU pool for a 68 minute window (approx 02:23–03:31 UTC).

Impact summary (prelim):
- Affected endpoints: POST /v1/tokens.generate (inbound requests from ArborAI routed through us-west)
- Customer error rate spike: from <0.1% to ~12% for the 68-minute window
- Observed increased latency for successful requests (p50 -> p95) and several 503 spikes

I have attached a short incident timeline and server metrics export (incident-timeline-2027-08-29.pdf). We are still finalizing the precise uptime calculation; I expect a follow-up once we reconcile logs across the gateway and the serving fleet.

If you want immediate remediation, we can propose a one-time token credit while we finish the audit. Please confirm whether ArborAI would like us to start the credit calculation now, and who on your side should be cc'd for billing.

Apologies for the disruption — we know this affected your production traffic.

— Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
Senior Incident Response Engineer
Redwood Inference

Attachments: incident-timeline-2027-08-29.pdf
From: Jordan Matthews <jordan@arborai.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: ArborAI Billing <billing@arborai.com>
Date: 2027-08-29T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Incident: token-generation errors impacting ArborAI (Aug 29)

Thanks Vivek — appreciate the quick note.

ArborAI saw request failures and client-side retries, which impacted several inference pipelines and one batch job. We will need written confirmation of eligibility for SLA credits and a proposed calculation method so we can reconcile on our end. Please include a clear start/end time window and the math used for the credit (hours of downtime, percentage, monthly committed value used in the formula).

Billing contact (please include on replies):
- ArborAI Billing <billing@arborai.com>

Next steps from our side: we can accept a provisional credit calculation for planning but will wait for the final reconciliation before applying to the invoice.

— Jordan
Jordan Matthews
Head of Platform — ArborAI
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-08-30T08:27:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Incident: token-generation errors impacting ArborAI (Aug 29) — credit request

Marissa / Karthik —

Forwarding Jordan's request. ArborAI is asking for: (1) formal statement of eligibility, (2) time window used, and (3) calculation steps so they can reconcile with their billing team. Vivek attached the timeline; can you two run the following and circle back by EOD 2027-09-01?

Action items:
- Vivek: confirm final incident boundaries (start/end timestamps in UTC), and share the filtered gateway logs used for the calculation.
- Karthik: prepare an initial credit calc using the standard SLA formula (percent outage * monthly committed spend pro-rated) and include a worked example in an .xlsx. Use the customer’s committed monthly spend of $48,000 (from HubSpot ARC-4512) unless legal flags otherwise.
- Marissa: please draft a customer-facing note describing the remedy and proposed timeline for issuance + any prerequisites (signed addendum if required).

We should aim to have a provisional number and customer note by 2027-09-01 COB. If legal needs to be looped, let me know; otherwise I will run final approval once Karthik posts the calc.

Thanks — will triage on priority.

— Soojin
Soojin Lee
Account Manager, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Matthews <jordan@arborai.com>, ArborAI Billing <billing@arborai.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-09-01T17:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: ArborAI outage - SLA credit request and calculation

Hi Jordan —

Thanks for your patience. Attached is our finalized calculation workbook (credit-calculation-arborai-20270901.xlsx) and the incident timeline PDF; we have also prepared a short credit addendum template if you want the adjustment applied to the next invoice (signed-credit-addendum.pdf).

Summary of findings and calculation (short):
- Final incident window (UTC): 2027-08-29T02:23:00Z to 2027-08-29T03:31:00Z (68 minutes).
- Impact classification: Partial outage affecting token generation for requests routed to us-west. Per SLA, ArborAI is eligible for a service credit for the measured downtime percentage above the 99.9% monthly uptime threshold.
- Monthly committed spend used for calc: $48,000 (ARC-4512).
- Calculation method: (Downtime minutes / Total minutes in billing month) -> outage percentage. Credit = outage percentage * committed monthly spend, pro-rated. See workbook for worked numbers.

Provisional numbers (rounded):
- Billing month minutes (Sept calendar example): 43,200 minutes.
- Outage minutes: 68 -> outage% = 0.1574%
- Pro-rated credit = 0.001574 * $48,000 ≈ $75.56 -> rounded to $76 for accounting.

Recommended next steps:
1) If ArborAI accepts, sign the one-time credit addendum and we will apply the $76 credit to your September invoice. (The addendum is optional for bookkeeping; we can also apply as an invoice adjustment without DocuSign if you prefer.)
2) We will publish the postmortem to the ArborAI shared folder and schedule a 30-minute sync (if you want) to walk through mitigations.

Notes: the credit above is conservative and follows our standard formula. If you want us to consider additional factors (e.g., downstream retries that lead to higher cost to you), we can open a reconciliation discussion but that will require mutual log correlation.

Attachments: credit-calculation-arborai-20270901.xlsx, signed-credit-addendum.pdf, incident-timeline-2027-08-29.pdf

Please reply to confirm whether you prefer the addendum route or a straight invoice adjustment.

Best —
Soojin Lee
Account Manager, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
